name: Residential Summer Engineering Program
what_you_do: Live on campus for a week and try six kinds of engineering. They are chemical, civil, environmental, computer, electrical and mechanical. You do lab work and meet industry pros. You also explore New York City.
who_can_apply: Students currently enrolled in 10th or 11th grade who are entering their junior or senior year. You must stay in the residence.
pay_detail: $2,500 total, which covers tuition, room and board, supplies and events.
duration: 7 days, Aug 1 to 7, 2027, living on campus
deadline_text: The page lists the 2027 dates but no registration deadline.
how_to_apply: The page lists the School of Engineering contact for details. The phone is 718-862-7281. The email is deanengr@manhattan.edu. No sign-up form is linked for this program.
notes: Parents can come to the closing ceremony and final project contest. Other short summer engineering programs on the same page cost less or are free.
